description: This file defines the CustomerOption class, which models an option for a customer, including its type, name, default value, and available values. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable for persistence and object serialization.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Represents a customer option with type, name, default value, and available options.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the customer option.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the customer option.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the customer option.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the customer option.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the customer option.

methods.name: getAvailableValues
methods.description: Returns the list of available values for this customer option.

methods.name: setAvailableValues
methods.description: Sets the list of available values for this customer option.
